dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem like you've drunk a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: No good hunting session is complete without a good drinking session afterwards!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: What's more, my daughter Diona is one of the top bartenders in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: That hasn't changed how much she nags me about my drinking, mind you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long is the hunt over for?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Until the next hunt, of course! Is that a trick question or something?
